source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
This companion supplements the Warhammer Event Companion for Doubles events, where teams of 2 players fight with their armies combined as one force against another team. It covers:

- the Doubles mission sequence: changes to generating a mission and setting up the battlefield
- Doubles terminology
- Core Rules changes for playing beside a teammate

For everything else, such as errata, FAQs, pairing and ranking, use the Warhammer Event Companion; Doubles events pair and rank whole teams, not players.
